name: bow
description: The first pose of the catapult launch sequence (pose `bow`, found with the pose editor): front legs squatted, back legs extended, claw closed and raised, all in one frame at the stand-up's pace, held 0.8 s, then back to where the run started. Played with `g2script bow --amount 1.0`: the run stands him up from rest with the eased stand-up first and lays him in rest after. A data skill clips the claw lift at 125, so it reaches 125 here, not the 135 the pose records.
